name: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich with Peppers, Pickled Onions & Dressed Greens (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
apple cider vinegar
½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb striploin (New York strip) steak
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
1 yellow bell pepper
1 green bell pepper
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips.

When the steak is done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add bell pepper, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Split buns in half and arrange on a baking sheet pan.

Place a ½-cup of cooked steak strips and 1 cup of sautéed bell pepper on a plate, then set aside for the kid plates. Return remaining steak strips to the skillet with the remaining bell pepper, stir to combine, then divide between 2 of the buns.

Coarsely grate cheese, then evenly sprinkle over all three buns (you will have a plain cheese bun for the kid plates). Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp brown sugar
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut toasted cheese bun in half and divide between plates, along with reserved steak and sautéed bell peppers. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide cheesesteak sandwiches and dressed greens between plates. Top sandwiches with pickled onions and enjoy!
